notes: Profile: mid‑enterprise e‑commerce marketplace that handles 150k monthly orders; returns peak during promo windows (2-3x baseline).
Primary ask: reliable, API-driven tool-calling from assistant -> internal systems: create/update RMA tickets, trigger refunds via payment gateway API, auto-escalate to ops when fraud flags present.
Latency/throughput target: sub-500ms end-to-end for agent interactions, batch-processing window for refunds up to 200 reqs/sec during spikes.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictable reserved throughput for peak weeks but wants tooling to optimize token spend for constant chat flows.
Model preferences: prefer open quantized models (Llama/Redwood-verified variants); want deterministic fallback to smaller model on surge.
Routing/fallback needs: multi-tier routing: hosted -> dedicated -> private (for sensitive workflows). Automatic fallback must preserve tool-calling contract.

Integration constraints: legacy order management system exposes SOAP endpoints for some operations; payment gateway uses HMAC-signed REST. Need Redwood runtime to support signed calls and connection pooling behind VPC.
Quote from CTO: "We need the assistant to actually do work — not just suggest. Tool calling reliability is non-negotiable during promo surge."
